segments.text: Hello and welcome to this module on risk mitigation.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎学习风险缓解模块。

segments.text: In this module, we will be discussing the application of the five controls,
segments.zh: 在本模块中，我们将讨论五种控制措施的应用，

segments.text: which are elimination, substitution, engineering controls,
segments.zh: 即消除、替代、工程控制、

segments.text: administrative controls, and personal protective equipment,
segments.zh: 管理控制和个人防护装备，

segments.text: which can be applied in conjunction with each other
segments.zh: 这些措施可以相互配合使用，

segments.text: to reduce the risks posed by operations involving biological agents.
segments.zh: 以降低涉及生物因子的操作所带来的风险。

segments.text: I am now at a Biosafety Level 3 facility,
segments.zh: 我现在位于一个生物安全三级设施，

segments.text: which is designated as a BSL-3 facility.
segments.zh: 它被指定为 BSL-3 设施。

segments.text: This is essentially a containment zone
segments.zh: 这基本上是一个防护区，

segments.text: in which researchers and laboratory workers
segments.zh: 研究人员和实验室工作人员

segments.text: can work with biological agents
segments.zh: 可以在这里使用生物因子，

segments.text: and conduct research in an environment
segments.zh: 并在一个能够限制

segments.text: which limits the risk posed by these biological agents.
segments.zh: 这些生物因子所带来风险的环境中开展研究。

segments.text: There are two types of containment,
segments.zh: 防护有两种类型，

segments.text: primary containment and secondary containment.
segments.zh: 一级防护和二级防护。

segments.text: Primary containment pertains to the protection
segments.zh: 一级防护是指

segments.text: of the laboratory user from the biological agent
segments.zh: 通过实施相应的控制措施，

segments.text: by the application of pertinent controls,
segments.zh: 保护实验室使用者免受生物因子的伤害，

segments.text: such as personal protective equipment and administrative controls.
segments.zh: 比如个人防护装备和管理控制。

segments.text: Secondary containment, on the other hand,
segments.zh: 而二级防护

segments.text: pertains to the protection of the environment
segments.zh: 是指通过实施适当的工程控制

segments.text: from the biological agent
segments.zh: 和标准操作规程，

segments.text: by the application of appropriate engineering controls
segments.zh: 保护环境免受

segments.text: and standard operating procedures.
segments.zh: 生物因子的影响。

segments.text: Both primary and secondary containment
segments.zh: 一级防护和二级防护

segments.text: can be applied in conjunction with each other
segments.zh: 可以相互配合使用，

segments.text: to limit the risk of exposure to biological agents.
segments.zh: 以限制暴露于生物因子的风险。

segments.text: This module, which follows,
segments.zh: 接下来的这个模块

segments.text: will focus on the application of pertinent controls
segments.zh: 将重点讨论如何运用相应的控制措施，

segments.text: to mitigate or limit the risk posed by biological agents.
segments.zh: 来缓解或限制生物因子带来的风险。

segments.text: We will now proceed to the slide presentation.
segments.zh: 下面我们进入幻灯片讲解。
